source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Each time a model of yours uses a **[Bondsman](vsdata:ability/imperial-knights.bondsman)** ability that no other model of yours has used this turn, it may pick up to 3 **ARMIGER** models of yours rather than 1:

- Each must be within 12" of the user, or 15" if your army is **[Honoured](vsdata:ability/imperial-knights.code-chivalric)**.
- None may already be under a Bondsman ability.

Those models are affected until your next **[Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase)** starts.
